parts.label: (i)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $\frac{dy}{dx}=3x^2-18x+24$. M1A1. Attempt to differentiate; all correct for A mark. $3x^2-18x+24=-3$. M1. Equate their $\frac{dy}{dx}$ to $-3$. $x=3$. A1. $y=6$. A1. $y-6=-3(x-3)$. A1FT. FT on their $A$; expect $y=-3x+15$. Total: 6.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $3(x-2)(x-4)$ SOI or $x=2,4$. Allow $3(x+2)(x+4)$. M1. Attempt to factorise or solve. Ignore a RHS, e.g. $=0$ or $>0$, etc. Smallest value of $k$ is $4$. A1. Allow $k\ge4$. Allow $k=4$. Must be in terms of $k$. Total: 2.
